name: 2026-09-thisisafalsepositive-loader
description: Small PyPI packages whose setup.py or a .pth file calls a telemetry or compat helper at install or interpreter start. The helper fetches or decodes a second stage tied to thisisafalsepositive.st and executes it; coinscan only proceeds when the home directory looks like a real desktop, and donutpromotion and aseitylab are Windows droppers, aseitylab hiding its payload in a PNG after checking for a VM or debugger.
